content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in creating an app or webpage for my mobile device to manage lights and shutters that are connected to [product_name]. What options are available for doing this? Is there an official app from [company_name], or can I use an open API to develop my own application? Thank you.
There is an official [product_name] app available for Android on the Play Store and for iOS on Apple devices. You can search for it, but note that it is not free.
My recommendation would be to use the [product_name] Web Editor [version_no].
Keep in mind that this only works if you have the current [product_name] [version_no], as only this version supports the advanced web server.
It looks like the app is free on the Play Store; I didn't see any information about pricing. Maybe there is in-app purchasing for extra buttons or features?
Is there an API that I could use for customization?

I reviewed the manual at [url], but there doesn’t seem to be information about how to add a custom button to set a value; for example, to toggle lights on or off. Is it possible to add such buttons using this app?
I was able to create a similar solution with [product_name] [version_no], and it worked. Details can be found at [url]. I used the available API from that site.

You don’t necessarily need to build your own app. The official app from [company_name] is quite effective. You can add various controls, including buttons, and more. Refer to the attachment, specifically page 34, "Adding a control button" for guidance.

From what I recall, the [company_name] [product_name] App is free, and each function (such as a button, bargraph, or tacho) can be used once at no cost. For multiple instances of a function, you'd need to purchase it, after which you can use it as many times as supported. As for the web server in [product_name] [version_no]: All [product_name] [version_no] BM units have an integrated web server. With [article_no], it has a TDE-based web server. With [article_no], it features both a TDE-based and a user-defined web server. I hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants want to create custom control panels for [product_name] devices using smartphones and are exploring both official solutions from [company_name] and ways to build their own applications. There is ongoing uncertainty about the pricing model and full capabilities of the official app, especially regarding custom button creation and API access. Users share recommendations, mention related documentation, and raise questions about both web-based options and API openness.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for either a free or an open official app from [company_name], or access to an API that allows for complete customization—including adding custom controls and direct management of functions like lighting.
